tip: Aluga-se uses passive se, so the verb agrees with its noun; the plural would be Alugam-se salas.
Apesar de means despite and is followed by an infinitive, as in apesar de estar doente.
Acabar de plus an infinitive means to have just done something: acabei de ler = I just read.
Assim que, meaning as soon as, takes the future subjunctive: assim que eu chegar = when I arrive.
Andar plus a gerund describes a recent ongoing habit: anda comendo = she's been eating lately.
